messages:
dario: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands: can we get a compact summary of planned headroom per region, how prewarm eviction works, and what customers should expect if we route across regions?

rachel_infra: Headroom: target ~20% in primary regions (us-west-2, eu-west-1), lower in tertiary regions (~8-10%). Composition = reserved + prewarm.

tom_ops: Eviction order is spot -> burst -> reserved. Prewarm nodes default to reserved semantics unless created with `preemptible=true`, in which case eviction weight is reduced.

priya_product: Console change: add toggle "Allow cross-region fallback (may affect latency/billing)" default OFF for Dedicated. Also expose per-region headroom % in the UI.

sam_support: CS blurb draft: "If you see 'served_with_fallback' it means we switched to a smaller model or routed to a fallback region. Check request logs for per-request details or contact support."

infra_bot: autoscaler: prewarm +3 us-west-2 scheduled for 2026-06-01T15:00Z (campaign).

rachel_infra: Metrics/alerts: emit `fallback.type` (variant|cross_region) and `fallback.latency_penalty_ms`. Alert `fallback.cross_region` will include from_region/to_region labels.

dario: Action items: Rachel -> eviction spec + metric labels; Priya -> console copy and toggle mock; Sam -> CS FAQ + incident tags. Can we have drafts by EOD Thursday?

rachel_infra: I'll open a short spec PR by Thursday EOD.

priya_product: I'll drop the mock and wording here when ready.

sam_support: I'll prepare the FAQ and incident tag template.

dario: Thanks all :rocket:
